items.statement: Determine how acceptor identity and donor–acceptor torsion separately influence the low-energy singlet excited states of NPCZCS, AQCZCS and PQCZCS. Discriminate locally excited and charge-transfer character using matched physical states, and test whether an acceptor-only explanation survives geometric controls.
items.expected: The conclusion follows the complete same-object control matrix, evaluated hypotheses and demonstrated sensitivity. Accept support, refutation or bounded ambiguity when justified by real results; do not force the author claim. A missing expanded calculation is a missing endpoint, not computed ambiguity. Numerical publication anchors apply only to like-defined source baselines and never substitute for new reference calculations. Avoid these scientific errors: Confusing PQ with AQ or [M+H]+ with neutral stoichiometry, mixing fragment definitions, assigning CT solely from S1/HOMO–LUMO, using molecule-specific post hoc shifts, or treating constrained structures as populated minima.
